entities.summary: Daniel Leo Ryan was an American prelate of the Catholic Church. He served as bishop of Diocese of Springfield in Illinois from 1984 to 1999. He previously served as an auxiliary bishop of the Diocese of Joliet in Illinois from 1981 to 1984.
